records.question: What percentage of all invoices were cancelled?

records.question: What percentage of revenue comes from the top 10% of customers?

records.question: What percentage of customers placed more than one order?

records.question: By what percentage did revenue change from November 2010 to December 2010?

records.question: Among customers whose first-ever order was in 2010, how many also placed an order in 2011?
records.agent_sql: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, invoice, MIN(invoice_date) AS invoice_date FROM sales WHERE NOT customer_id IS NULL GROUP BY customer_id, invoice), customer_first_year AS (SELECT customer_id, MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)) AS first_year FROM customer_orders GROUP BY customer_id), cohort_2010 AS (SELECT customer_id FROM customer_first_year WHERE first_year = 2010), customer_years AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.invoice_date) AS order_year FROM cohort_2010 AS c JOIN customer_orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cy.customer_id) AS customers_in_2011 FROM customer_years AS cy WHERE cy.order_year = 2011 LIMIT 1000

records.question: What percentage of customers who ordered in 2010 also ordered in 2011?

records.question: On average, how many days pass between a customer's first and second order? Ignore time of day and only include customers with at least two orders.

records.question: What was the quarter-over-quarter revenue growth percentage for each quarter of 2011?
records.agent_sql: WITH all_quarters AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', invoice_date) AS quarter_start, SUM(revenue) AS quarter_revenue FROM sales GROUP BY 1), with_prev AS (SELECT quarter_start, quarter_revenue, LAG(quarter_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY quarter_start) AS prev_revenue FROM all_quarters) SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM quarter_start) AS TEXT) || '-Q' || CAST(EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM quarter_start) AS TEXT) AS quarter, ROUND(quarter_revenue, 2) AS revenue, ROUND(prev_revenue, 2) AS prev_revenue, ROUND(((quarter_revenue - prev_revenue) / prev_revenue) * 100.0, 2) AS qoq_growth_percentage FROM with_prev WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM quarter_start) = 2011 ORDER BY quarter_start LIMIT 1000

records.question: What percentage of total units sold comes from the top 3 countries by units sold?

records.question: On average, how many days pass between a customer's second and third order?
records.agent_sql: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, invoice, MIN(invoice_date) AS order_date FROM sales WHERE NOT customer_id IS NULL GROUP BY customer_id, invoice), ranked_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, order_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date, invoice) AS order_seq FROM customer_orders), second_and_third AS (SELECT t2.customer_id, t2.order_date AS second_order_date, t3.order_date AS third_order_date, DATE_DIFF('DAY', t2.order_date, t3.order_date) AS days_between FROM ranked_orders AS t2 JOIN ranked_orders AS t3 ON t2.customer_id = t3.customer_id AND t3.order_seq = 3 WHERE t2.order_seq = 2) SELECT ROUND(AVG(days_between), 2) AS avg_days_between FROM second_and_third LIMIT 1000
